welcome.subject: Your Three Wolves profile is here 🐺
welcome.text:
Kia ora Mia,

We've just launched your own Three Wolves profile: your membership, bookings, results and photos, all in one place.
Your account is ready. We've set it up with this email address, so sign in with it and you'll see your membership straight away.

Open my profile: https://club.wording.test/login?email=mia%40wording.test

What's new:
- No passwords, ever: sign in with a 6-digit code by email or text message.
- Your membership in your pocket: book and pay for play days, switch between monthly and quarterly from your next renewal, update your card or download receipts.
- Club shop: the Port Hills Dawn jersey, $30, men's and women's S to 3XL. Pay by card online or cash at a play day.
- Your game, tracked: attendance and round-robin results (2 points per win) and the club leaderboard: https://club.wording.test/leaderboard
- Share your court-side shots to the club Gallery, and download originals.
- Message the club from your profile. Add it to your home screen; English and Tiếng Việt.

You're on the leaderboard by default. Hide me from the leaderboard: https://club.wording.test/profile/settings?optout=x

Questions? Send us a message from your profile, or email threewolvesbadminton@gmail.com.

See you on court,
The Three Wolves team
welcome.html:
Sign in with a code, manage your membership, grab the new jersey and see where you rank.
New for the pack

Your Three Wolves profile is here

 

Kia ora Mia,

We've just launched something we've wanted for a long time: your own Three Wolves profile. Your membership, bookings, results and photos are now all in one place, on your phone or computer.

Your account is ready. We've set it up with this email address, so sign in with it and you'll see your membership straight away.

Open my profile
What's new
🔑 No passwords, ever
Sign in with a 6-digit code sent to your email or by text message. You'll stay signed in on that device for 90 days.
🏸 Your membership, in your pocket
See your plan and next renewal date, then:
  • book and pay for play days from the club calendar;
  • switch between monthly and quarterly, starting at your next renewal;
  • update your card or download receipts any time.
Not a member yet? Join right from your profile.
Club shop
Port Hills Dawn jersey
$30
Men's and women's fits, S to 3XL. Pay by card online, or in cash at a play day, and collect it at your next session.
📈 Your game, tracked
Your attendance and round-robin results now build up on your profile, at 2 points for every win. The new club leaderboard ranks the pack by month, quarter, year and all time.
You're on it by default. Prefer to keep your results private? Hide me from the leaderboard (one tap), or turn off "Show me on the leaderboard" in your profile any time.
📸 Share your court-side shots
Upload photos from your profile to the club Gallery. We remove location data before anything is shared, and every photo is checked before it goes up. Spotted yourself in the Gallery? Tap Download original for the full-quality version.
💬 Message the club
Questions about your membership or a play day? Send them from your profile and we'll reply there.
📱 Works like an app
Add it to your home screen and it opens full-screen. Available in English and Tiếng Việt.
Casual players: nothing changes. You can still book a session as a guest. A free account is there whenever you want to track your games or join the leaderboard.

This is the first version, so tell us what you think. Send us a message from your profile, or email threewolvesbadminton@gmail.com.

See you on court,

The Three Wolves team
Three Wolves Badminton Club · Christchurch, NZ
